# Handling under the handbook

In the dry reading room, check that the lantern badge is amber and its valve is closed. Both conditions are necessary. READY permits moving the lantern; it does not permit opening the valve. A blue badge does not qualify.

The handbook supplies no humid-room rule and no physical mechanism or evidence of effectiveness. These are stated fictional instructions, not a verified safety procedure. [Rule](kb:passage:handling-rule@1) [Limits](kb:passage:handling-limits@1)
